newsitem.title: GERMANY: Agfa to buy Dupont graphical, offset units.
newsitem.headline: Agfa to buy Dupont graphical, offset units.

text.p: Bayer AG unit Agfa-Gevaert AG said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with U.S.-based DuPont to buy DuPont's graphical film and offset printing plates activities.
It said in a statement the units to be acquired had sales of nearly 900 million marks in 1996. DuPont said in the Agfa statement it expected an unspecified one-off charge on results from the deal.
Agfa said however that DuPont's photopolymer proofing and Cyrel flexible printing plate activities were not included in the deal and would continue to be run by the U.S. firm.
Agfa said it expected to takeover the majority of the 2,200 staff employed by the two DuPont units at facilities in Germany and Britain.
